color.$description: Semantic color contract. Every token documents its fallback value here; see section 4 of plan.md.

border.$description: Decorative separators only; not load-bearing for meaning.

border-strong.$description: Input borders and control outlines. 3.52:1 vs surface.

text-muted.$description: Secondary text and helper copy. 6.64:1 vs surface.

primary-fg.$description: Text and icon color on top of --sk-color-primary.

danger-fg.$description: Danger text and icons on light surfaces.

success-fg.$description: Success text and icons on light surfaces.

warning-fg.$description: Warning text and icons on light surfaces.

accent-coral.$description: Decoration and data-viz accent. Never the sole carrier of state.

accent-mint.$description: Decoration and data-viz accent. Never the sole carrier of state.

focus-ring.$description: Focus indicator. 7.10:1 vs surface; 3:1 against adjacent colors.
